name: Imp no Kuni Tori Dai Sakusen
original_name: インプの国盗り大作戦
source:
A weak and useless imp steps up to the challenge of overthrowing a human kingdom! What will she due in the face of wave after wave of soldiers, and the four mighty generals...?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ402762.html/?unique_op=af&locale=en_US]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一个软弱无用的小恶魔挺身而出，迎接推翻人类王国的挑战！面对一波又一波的士兵，以及四位威武将军，她将面临怎样的结局……？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ402762.html/?unique_op=af&locale=en_US]DLsite[/url]]
